correctness.rationale: Actual rational midpoint-key ordering gives cuts 1 and n-1 as cycles of length (n+1)/2 with supports meeting at exactly one point. Their commutators produce mixed three-cycles, which generate A_n. The cycles are odd iff n=3 mod4; at n=1 mod4 the second cut has 4t-1 cross-packet inversions and therefore is odd. Independent exact Fraction-generated permutations and Schreier group orders: n=3,5,7,9 give two-cut orders 6,60,5040,181440 and three-cut orders 6,120,5040,362880. Identity cut has positive binomial mass, so finite-group random walk is irreducible, aperiodic and uniform stationary. No mixing time is proved.
